name: Accessibility baseline
description: Helpers that make the common accessibility requirements easy: 44 point tap targets, Reduce Motion aware animation, and scaled spacing for Dynamic Type.
usage: Use `.minimumTapTarget()` on small icon buttons, `.motionAwareAnimation(.spring, value: x)` instead of `.animation` for decorative motion, and `@ScaledMetric` spacing via `ScaledSpacing`. Give icon-only buttons a text label (`Label` or `.accessibilityLabel`). Mark section titles with `.accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)`.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify accessibility-baseline` on a Mac with Xcode.
